entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 15863: position at J1991.25; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 20902: the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 6.44 +/- 0.17 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ac2431): 155.28 +/- 4.099 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 15863 (same row): 23.75, -26.23 mas/yr. Radial velocity from Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331, XHIP, HIP 15863: RV -2.04 +/- 0.05 km/s (quality A).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 53.07 +/- 1.45 solar radii from Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 20902: radius 53.07 +1.37/-1.45 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 3.18 +/- 0.008 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ac2431). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5859 +/- 41 K from Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 20902: effective temperature 5859 +/- 41 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Mirfak is HR 1017., cross-checked against Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 180: HR 1017; VizieR III/202 (5 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fbf7ff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 20902 is not in the library; gaia-xp: the star is placed by a catalogue row, so no Gaia DR3 source is read for it; kiehling: HR 1017 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: found, not needed after the color and its cross-check; pulkovo: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,859 K and log g 1.31 (u1 0.464, u2 0.232): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
